old_text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
old_text: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
new_text: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
mapping_notes: Section number changed significantly; content largely same with enhanced provisions

old_title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
old_text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, or anything which is signed or sealed, and which is capable of being converted into a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
new_text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property to any person, or to make, alter or destroy the whole or any part of a valuable security, or anything which is signed or sealed, and which is capable of being converted into a valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
old_text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
new_title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
new_text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

old_text: Where the death of a woman is caused by any burns or bodily injury or occurs otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of her marriage and it is shown that soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by her husband or any relative of her husband for, or in connection with, any demand for dowry, such death shall be called dowry death.
new_text: Where the death of a woman is caused by any burns or bodily injury or occurs otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of her marriage and it is shown that soon before her death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by her husband or any relative of her husband for, or in connection with, any demand for dowry, such death shall be called dowry death.

old_text: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
old_text: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
new_text: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than one year but which may extend to five years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_text: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
new_text: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

old_text: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
old_text: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
new_title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
new_text: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

old_text: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
new_text: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.

old_text: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
new_text: Whoever, voluntarily causes hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

old_title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
old_text: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 335, voluntarily causes grievous hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: Whoever, voluntarily causes grievous hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_text: Whoever is guilty of rioting, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
new_text: Whoever is guilty of rioting, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.

old_text: Whoever is a party to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for a term of two years or upwards, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had abetted such offence.
new_text: Whoever is a party to a criminal conspiracy to commit an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for a term of two years or upwards, shall be punished in the same manner as if he had abetted such offence.

old_text: If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
new_text: If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.

old_title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
old_text: Whoever, intending to insult the modesty of any woman, utters any word, makes any sound or gesture, or exhibits any object, intending that such word or sound shall be heard, or that such gesture or object shall be seen, by such woman, or intrudes upon the privacy of such woman, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, and also with fine.
new_title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
new_text: Whoever, intending to insult the modesty of any woman, utters any word, makes any sound or gesture, or exhibits any object, intending that such word or sound shall be heard, or that such gesture or object shall be seen, by such woman, or intrudes upon the privacy of such woman, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years, and also with fine.

old_text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him or under his direction, and be read over to the informant.
new_text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him or under his direction, and be read over to the informant. The information shall also be given through electronic communication.
mapping_notes: Added provision for electronic FIR filing

old_text: Any police officer making an investigation may examine orally any person supposed to be acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case.
new_text: Any police officer making an investigation may examine orally any person supposed to be acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case. Audio-video recording of such examination may be done.
mapping_notes: Added provision for audio-video recording of witness examination

old_title: When police may arrest without warrant
old_text: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest any person who has been concerned in any cognizable offence.
new_title: When police may arrest without warrant
new_text: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest any person who has been concerned in any cognizable offence. The arrested person shall be informed of the grounds of arrest and the right to bail.
mapping_notes: Enhanced rights of arrested person to be informed

old_title: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in twenty-four hours
old_text: Whenever any person is arrested and detained in custody, and it appears that the investigation cannot be completed within the period of twenty-four hours, the officer in charge of the police station shall transmit to the nearest Judicial Magistrate a copy of the entries in the diary.
new_title: Procedure when investigation cannot be completed in twenty-four hours
new_text: Whenever any person is arrested and detained in custody, and it appears that the investigation cannot be completed within the period of twenty-four hours, the officer in charge of the police station shall transmit to the nearest Judicial Magistrate a copy of the entries in the diary.

old_title: When bail may be taken in case of non-bailable offence
old_text: When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant by an officer in charge of a police station or appears or is brought before a Court other than the High Court or Court of Session, he may be released on bail.
new_title: When bail may be taken in case of non-bailable offence
new_text: When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant by an officer in charge of a police station or appears or is brought before a Court other than the High Court or Court of Session, he may be released on bail.
mapping_notes: Substantively identical; bail provisions enhanced elsewhere

old_text: Evidence means and includes all statements which the Court permits or requires to be made before it by witnesses, in relation to matters of fact under inquiry, and all documents including electronic records produced for the inspection of the Court.
new_text: Evidence means and includes all statements which the Court permits or requires to be made before it by witnesses, in relation to matters of fact under inquiry, and all documents including electronic records and semiconductor memory produced for the inspection of the Court.
mapping_notes: Added semiconductor memory to the definition of evidence

old_text: When the Court has to form an opinion upon a point of foreign law or of science or art, or as to identity of handwriting or finger impressions, the opinions upon that point of persons specially skilled in such foreign law, science or art, or in questions as to identity of handwriting or finger impressions are relevant facts.
new_text: When the Court has to form an opinion upon a point of foreign law or of science or art, or as to identity of handwriting or finger impressions, the opinions upon that point of persons specially skilled in such foreign law, science or art, or in questions as to identity of handwriting or finger impressions, including electronic evidence, are relevant facts.
mapping_notes: Added electronic evidence to expert opinion scope

old_text: Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media produced by a computer shall be deemed to be also a document.
new_text: Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media produced by a computer shall be deemed to be also a document, if the conditions mentioned in this section are satisfied.
